async def act(page):
    commit_links = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has=page.get_by_role('link', name='Eric Bailey'))
    count = 0
    for i in range(await commit_links.count()):
        commit_link = commit_links.nth(i)
        full_text = await commit_link.inner_text()
        if '2024-03-02' in full_text:
            count += 1
        return full_text
